newsitem.title: CHINA: China Q1 output of plastic film seen 230,000 T.
newsitem.headline: China Q1 output of plastic film seen 230,000 T.

text.p: China's output of agricultural plastic film was seen at 230,000 tonnes in the first quarter of 1997, little-changed from the same period last year, an official said on Tuesday.
That supply would meet demand for the spring planting season, the official of the Chinese General Association of Light Industry said by telephone.
The total demand of plastic film for 1997 was estimated at 850,000 tonnes, she said without giving further details.
China's output of plastic film for agricultural use reached a record of 698,000 tonnes in 1996.
